messages:
zoe (eng-security): heads-up: upstream pushed a runc/OCI change that expands syscall surface for certain uid mappings. we should coordinate an urgent base-image rebuild, introduce attestation hooks, and run an audit backfill for some broad builder grants last week. propose to use HSM-backed keywrap for signing so we don't re-enable long-lived signer perms.

juan (eng-runtime): agreed. plan: automated rebuild -> staging push -> attestation + SBOM diff -> runtime fuzz -> 1% canary -> rollout. also want a canary fallback to "runc-slim" runtime if we observe ptrace/prctl anomalies.

max (eng-infra): infra can schedule a 30m maintenance window tonight at 01:30 UTC. will freeze builders for the cut. question: which principal will perform cosign (HSM) unwrap? we need to ensure registry ACLs accept the new signer identity.

ari (sec): prefer issuing an ephemeral KMS-wrapped signing key (HSM KEK) and using workload-identity-runner to unwrap for the pipeline. avoids granting iam.permissions to build-service. i'll also run the audit backfill for the window 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-12T00:00:00Z to capture any manual iam.AppendRole/SetIamPolicy actions.

zoe (eng-security): include structured audit events from the pipeline for: build:start, image:push, image:attest, key:unwrap, image:sign. example JSON: {"actor":"svc:build-runner","event":"image:attest","sbom":"sha256:...","signer":"kms-hsm://projects/redwood/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/attest"}. ari, can sec ingest that?

ari (sec): yes. add an "rbac_diff" field if any role grants happen during the window so we can quickly filter.

ci-bot: job queued: id=rbld-17776-stg initiator=zoe. watch: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/rbld-17776-stg

juan (eng-runtime): runtime checklist for rebuilt image:
- Dockerfile: ENV GCO_FORCE_NO_NEW_PRIVS=1, set no_new_privs in image metadata
- drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_MKNOD, CAP_SYS_MODULE in entrypoint
- include attestation sidecar that posts SBOM to attest-api and waits for attest ok before promoting
- enable core collector and extended kprobe probes for prctl/ptrace/syscall counts

max (eng-infra): infra tasks:
- tag push to staging with explicit metadata: build-id, signer-key, attest-token
- cosign sign using HSM-wrapped key: cosign sign --key ksmhsm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/build/cryptoKeys/attest
- expose quick-revoke endpoint for registry to mark image untrusted if needed

ari (sec): suggested audit query for backfill:
logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"build-service@redwood" OR protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"ops@redwood"
protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "projects.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy")
timestamp>="2026-03-10T00:00:00Z" AND timestamp<"2026-03-12T00:00:00Z"
correlate with gs://redwood-build-logs/*/rbld-* and KMS HSM key access logs.

zoe (eng-security): if we find any image signed by the old principal in that window, label those builds as "untrusted" and run rbld-resign job that reads artifacts from GCS and re-signs with ephemeral HSM key. add incident tag incident:attest-sign-drift.

ci-bot: job rbld-17776-stg started: runner=builder-2 image=debian-14+runc-patched

juan (eng-runtime): post-build staging smoke to run:
kubectl run attest-canary --rm -i --image=registry.staging.redwood/base:attest --restart=Never --overrides='{"spec":{"containers":[{"securityContext":{"allowPrivilegeEscalation":false}}]}}' && kubectl logs attest-canary
also start runtime-fuzzer for 25m; auto-rollback on >2 kernel oops in 5m.

max (eng-infra): cosign/HSM sign recorded. pipeline emitted structured audit events to gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-17776-stg/audit.jsonl. registry push tag=staging+sha. quick-revoke endpoint ready.

ari (sec): starting audit backfill now. will paste CSV to ticket when done. initial scan for SetIamPolicy shows a temporary grant to build-service on 2026-03-11T03:12:08Z; correlating sign events now.

ci-bot: job rbld-17776-stg completed: result=SUCCESS duration=13m artifacts at gs://redwood-build-logs/rbld-17776-stg/

ari (sec): audit correlation: sign events during the window are all by ephemeral HSM unwrap principal except one older push by build-service@redwood at 2026-03-11T03:14:02Z. marking that artifact untrusted and triggering rbld-resign. CSV attached to ticket.

zoe (eng-security): thanks. infra run rbld-resign immediately and flag the registry entry as revoked. runtime start canary and watch probes. owners: max=infra & revoke/resign, juan=runtime tests & canary fallback, ari=KMS/audit correlation, zoe=sec lead + incident runbook.

juan (eng-runtime): canary up. eBPF probes show normal syscall distribution so far. no ptrace spikes in first 10m. fallback plan ready if triggers occur.

max (eng-infra): rbld-resign job ran, artifacts re-signed with HSM ephemeral key, registry flag cleared after verification. posted link to re-signed artifacts in ticket.

ari (sec): postmortem note: add a rule to prevent granting iam.serviceAccounts.actAs to build-service without a pre-approved ephemeral keyflow. adding that to runbook.

zoe (eng-security): closing coordination thread; runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/hsm-attest-rebuild-2026. thanks all. :lock:
